ShortDescription.Value: Early-alpha manual service access editing. Remote Service Point remains experimental.

Publish.LongDescription:
EARLY ALPHA — REMOTE SERVICE POINT IS EXPERIMENTAL.
WHAT IT DOES Inspect supported buildings and try an alternate service-access road. Remote mode experiments with a service interaction point on a nearby road while retaining normal frontage.
HOW TO USE Open Access Studio, select a building, inspect its current access, choose Move Service Access and select an alternate road. Reset Vanilla restores the captured access state.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS Use a disposable test city. Supported buildings and networks vary; vanilla pathfinding still decides actual service routing. Remote mode, service combinations, target-road deletion and save/load behavior do not have complete runtime coverage. Overrides are transient and cleanup is attempted on city transition/unload; this is not a save-safety guarantee.
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.3.3-alpha.1 — Maintenance beta
Added restoration of transient access overrides on city preload and system destruction. Remote access remains early alpha; no new service-routing verification is claimed.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
